definitions.explanation: An entertainment facility with various arcade games including video games, crane games, rhythm games, and more.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧{帰|がえ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ゲーセン⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄|よ}った→寄る：02440_yoru⟧。
examples.english: I stopped by the arcade on the way home from school.

examples.japanese: ゲーセン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦クレーンゲーム→クレーンゲーム：17040_kureengeemu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やった→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
examples.english: I played a crane game at the arcade.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、ゲーセン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}って→減る：01985_heru⟧きて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, arcades have been decreasing in number.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦ゲームセンター→ゲームセンター：27104_geemusentaa⟧ (game center) ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{略|りゃく}→略：21443_ryaku⟧ - abbreviation of game center

COMMON GAMES:
- ⟦クレーンゲーム→クレーンゲーム：17040_kureengeemu⟧/UFOキャッチャー (crane/claw machine)
- {音|おと}ゲー (rhythm games)
- ⟦{格|かく}ゲー→格ゲー：16639_kakugee⟧ (fighting games)
- ⟦メダル→メダル：10162_medaru⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧ (medal games)
- プリクラ (photo sticker booths)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese arcades (ゲーセン) are known for having the latest and most advanced arcade games. They remain popular despite the rise of home gaming, particularly for rhythm games and social experiences.
